# Code of Conduct

The Symbiote community welcomes people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are committed to making project spaces respectful, constructive, and safe for participation.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate, patient, and respectful.
- Discuss ideas and work rather than attacking people.
- Give and receive constructive feedback in good faith.
- Respect differing viewpoints and experiences.
- Protect other people's privacy; do not publish private or identifying information without permission.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, intimidation, personal attacks, sexualized conduct, threats, doxxing, and repeated disruptive behavior are not acceptable. This applies to project discussions, issues, pull requests, events, and other spaces where someone is representing or participating in the Symbiote community.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns privately to [hello@artifactvirtual.com](mailto:hello@artifactvirtual.com) with the subject "Symbiote Code of Conduct". Please include what happened, where it occurred, and any context needed to review it. Do not use public issues for sensitive reports. For security vulnerabilities, follow the separate process in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Enforcement

Project maintainers will review reports fairly and privately, and will share details only with people who need them to respond. Depending on the circumstances, maintainers may remove content, issue a warning, restrict participation, or exclude someone from project spaces. Retaliation against someone who raises a concern or assists with a review is not acceptable.
